title: Oasis Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Recently updated with new furnishings and accessories, OASIS it the epitome of coastal style! Every detail speaks to beachy comfort making your stay unforgettable. Located on Forest Street, the cottage sits near the beach.
description_expanded: Description743 FOREST STREET2 KINGS, 2 BUNK BEDS, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 10) Prime Seaside Location on a Quiet StreetWelcome to Oasis, a recently updated and beautifully renovated Seaside home featuring new furnishings, refreshed interiors, and exceptional outdoor living spaces. Perfectly positioned on a quiet, less-traveled street, this inviting retreat is just a short walk to the beach, the West Side family pool, and downtown Seaside’s shops and restaurants — offering the ideal blend of convenience and tranquility.Charming Arrival & Inviting Outdoor SpacesGuests arrive to find two designated parking spaces directly in front of the home — easily recognized by its cheerful bright yellow front door. The experience begins on the first of three outdoor porches, an open-air front porch furnished with Adirondack seating for three. This sunny space overlooks the side yard and is a favorite spot for morning coffee or unwinding after a beach day.Open-Concept Living with Screened Porch AccessStep inside to a spacious open floor plan designed for gathering and relaxation. The main level features a renovated kitchen, adjacent dining area, comfortable living room, a full bathroom, and access to a full-length screened-in rear porch.The updated kitchen is equipped with new stainless-steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator, and a generous breakfast bar with seating for four. The dining area offers flexible seating for six to eight guests with bench seating, while the living room provides two oversized slip-covered sofas, a club chair, and a large mounted flat-screen TV with soundbar. One sofa converts to a queen sleeper, accommodating additional guests. A renovated full bathroom on this level includes a single vanity and a glass-enclosed shower with a rain shower head.Screened Porch & Private Backyard RetreatJust off the living space, the second porch is a standout feature — a large screened-in porch running the length of the home. This favorite gathering space includes a lounge seating area with a sofa and two club chairs, plus bar-top seating for two, making it perfect for alfresco dining or evening cocktails.Beyond the porch, guests will find a private rear deck with a charcoal grill, outdoor shower, and chaise lounger, all surrounded by a lush, well-maintained yard enclosed with a classic white picket fence.Upstairs Bedrooms & Third Porch EscapeThe second floor is home to all three bedrooms and the third porch, offering even more space to relax. The primary suite features a spacious king bed, ample storage, a flat-screen smart TV, and a renovated ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain shower head. The primary also enjoys direct access to the screened-in upstairs porch.The upstairs screened porch is a true retreat, complete with a bed swing and large sectional lounge — an ideal afternoon reading nook or evening wine spot.The second bedroom offers a king bed, smart TV, double-door closet, and access to a shared renovated full bathroom. The third bedroom is a kids’ favorite bunk room with two twin bunks, dresser, smart TV, and access to the same shared bathroom. This full bathroom includes double vanities and a tub/shower combination.A Family Favorite in the Heart of SeasideWith three exceptional porches, thoughtfully updated interiors, and a prime walkable location, Oasis makes choosing a favorite coffee spot part of the fun. This welcoming Seaside home is a longtime family favorite, offering comfort, style, and unbeatable access to everything Seaside has to offer.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,780 square feet5-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at West Ruskin PavilionSmart TVs in every bedroomDedicated desk for working remotelyPrivate designated parking for two vehicles directly in front of the homeConvenient bike rack accommodating up to four bikesWasher & dryerThree furnished porches with a well-maintained yard and deckPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeResort-style amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001873
